instruction: Calculate the sales commission (5% of revenue where revenue = Retail Price × Quantity × (1 - Discount)) in column K according to the Retail Price sheet, and sum the total commission in cell K37.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating 5% commission on revenue in column K and summing in K37. Verified with Python: K2=$30.24 (5% of $604.83), K3=$29.52 (5% of $590.37), Total=$649.26 (5% of total revenue $12985.17).
